cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need help running the raffle. I've made you a deputy badge; you may put it on.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I be co-organizer? I sold all the tickets.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your sales are approved. My deputy may arrange the prizes while I conduct the draw.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I announce the winners? I know most of the ticket holders.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Announcements are authorized. I'll draw and show you the number; you may add the winner's name once I've confirmed the ticket.

reason: Rereading found that knowing most of them could refer to winners before the draw, implying unprepared foreknowledge. Specify ticket holders so B familiarity legitimately supports announcement help.
